# Introduction

Hello, and welcome.

My name is Terrill Li, and I am an undergraduate student in the Bachelor of Mathematical Sciences program at the University of Sydney, commencing in Semester 2, 2026.

# About This Website

I created this website to document my mathematical journey. Here I share reading notes, proof diaries, essays, projects, and reflections as I continue learning. Rather than presenting polished conclusions alone, I hope this website records the gradual development of my understanding over time.

# Academic Interests

I am currently interested in pure mathematics, particularly probability, stochastic processes, analysis, and the foundational ideas that underpin modern mathematics. As I progress through my studies, I hope to develop a deeper understanding of rigorous mathematical reasoning and eventually contribute to mathematical research.

# Broader Interests

Beyond mathematics itself, I am also interested in how artificial intelligence is reshaping learning, research, and knowledge-based professions. Rather than viewing AI as a replacement for deep understanding, I believe its rapid development makes strong theoretical foundations even more valuable. A solid understanding of first principles enables us to critically evaluate AI-generated explanations, recognize their assumptions and limitations, and use AI as a tool for learning rather than a substitute for thinking.

# Learning Philosophy

I believe that the widespread use of AI has fundamentally changed the way we learn. Rather than reducing the importance of mathematics, AI makes a deep understanding of first principles even more essential. Strong theoretical foundations enable us to critically evaluate AI-generated explanations, understand their assumptions, recognize potential errors, and apply them effectively instead of accepting them uncritically.
